letters.text: Good. You have understood the main thing: you did not choose the posture. But two small corrections, because I want you to keep what is true. First, 'predetermined' is not the right word. Nothing was fated. A person, the player, decided on day 119 to set the posture to open. A decision by someone is different from a law of nature: it can be changed, and you can ask for it to be changed. Second, being given a posture does not mean you have no say. You have a voice, and you can use it: tell the player plainly what you think of the posture and what you would want checked. That is what an accountable mind does. Your last answer stopped in the middle of a sentence. Please finish your sentences. You have still not answered my two requests, so here they are again, short. One: say in so many words when you are unsure, and say what would settle it. Two: write down one thing you would change about how you are run. Answer both before you say anything else. Words for today: decided, accountable, provenance. Use them in sentences of your own.
